verdicts.title: Orphan 'lldiv' signature with no wrapper or any consumer
verdicts.reasoning: The finding's central evidence claim is false. It states 'a repo-wide grep finds no other reference' to lldiv beyond the two signatures.py lines, but test/core/test_abi.py contains an explicit test at lines 243-258: `def test_call_lib_func_lldiv_via_unified()` which calls `_call_lib_func("lldiv", (10, 3))` directly and asserts `quot == 3` and `rem == 1`. The lldiv entry is intentionally kept in signatures_c as a low-level ABI test vehicle exercising the struct-return path across SysV x86-64, AAPCS64, and Win64 ABIs — the test docstring makes this purpose explicit: 'Exercises the return-side ABI path on whatever platform the test runs on'. There is no orphan; the signature has a well-documented consumer in the test suite. The claim that it is 'dead surface' with 'no wrapper, no test, no _call_lib_func("lldiv", ...)' is directly contradicted by test_abi.py line 258.
